feeds.description: Browse through some of my favorite psychedelic rock music in this section. This is my music blog. It will contain my comments on the artists, albums and tracks that I like, with links to the tunes themselves wherever possible. It will cover a wide range of genres: indie, alternative, rock, jazz, folk, pop, a smattering of classical, and everything in between.
